# Coding Bible

> Opinionated, structured engineering standards for software that is easy to understand, difficult to misuse, and pleasant to maintain.

Coding Bible is rules-first. Stable rule IDs, rationale, severity, examples, exceptions, references, and detection metadata live in one canonical registry. Use the compact resources below for machine consumption rather than scraping the rendered website.

## Agent resources

- [Full rule context](https://xanhast-pf.github.io/coding-bible/llms-full.txt): Complete Markdown context with all 128 rules, rationale, examples, exceptions, and references.
- [Rules JSON](https://xanhast-pf.github.io/coding-bible/rules.json): Versioned machine-readable rule export.
- [Rules JSON Schema](https://xanhast-pf.github.io/coding-bible/rules.schema.json): JSON Schema for the stable export contract.
- [Compact all-rules prompt](https://xanhast-pf.github.io/coding-bible/agents/all.txt): Token-conscious agent instructions for the entire current rule set.
